question: What command is directed to the great Garuda regarding evil serpents in this mantra?
premises: The great Garuda is summoned to come.
Evil serpents are named as targets.
The practitioner must utter this command.
inference: The mantra commands the great Garuda to come and address the evil serpents.
plain_english: One should say: come, come, O great Garuda, the word concerning the evil serpents.
